title: Summer 2027: Industrial Design Intern (May through August)

facts.summary: Summer ID intern on SharkNinja's product design team.
facts.duties: Sketches and renders concepts, builds prototypes, makes production CAD with engineering, and specifies CMF.
facts.requirements: SolidWorks or Rhino, KeyShot, and a portfolio that shows product development process.
facts.apply: Apply on Greenhouse and include work samples, either linked in the resume or added as a cover letter.
